answers: lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — The design already addresses this via Gap 11. The finding describes the scenario where after the from-stage target unit (a cycle) is found and `skip_until_stage` is cleared, `resume_mode` remains `true`, causing the resume skip guard to activate for all subsequent leaf stages marked complete. Gap 11 in the Context/gaps section documents this explicitly and specifies the fix: in both dispatch-unit arms (cycle:* and stage:*) of `main()` in runner.sh, immediately after clearing `skip_until_stage`, also set `resume_mode=false` — preventing the resume skip guard from activating for stages after `<s>`. Pure resume runs (no from-stage) never set `skip_until_stage` so this change is unreachable in that path. DSFSTG-3[code] pins the observable behavior: a 3-unit fixture [intake (leaf), cyc (cycle), verify (leaf)] with all three stages marked complete in an interrupted run, invoked with `--resume --from-stage cyc`, must dispatch verify even though it was marked complete. This test fails on old code (verify skipped because `resume_mode` stays `true`) and passes after the fix. Finding 31 in the Findings section also explicitly confirms this is addressed.
